fusions.name: Drawn to the Blade
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimmed Dross
fusions.desc: Flings off skimmed dross, dealing 10 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You regain 6 health. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Proof Against Taint
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, no condition can take hold of you and blows that reach you deal no damage, and you regain 8 health at once. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Nothing to Corrode
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% poison resistance.
